description: Purview.Aspire.ResourceKit composes an Aspire AppHost from strongly typed kits at runtime, and generates the wiring that makes that possible at build time. The direction that matters is build-time-tooling-may-not-know-the-runtime: the Roslyn components are loaded into a consumer's compiler, so a reference to the runtime from one of them would drag Aspire.Hosting into every consumer's compiler host.

responsibilities.name: ResourceKit
responsibilities.purpose: The runtime model an AppHost composes: host and resource kit base types, generated options, run modes and OptionsHelper. This is the composition root's own library, and the only project packed for consumers.
responsibilities.mayRemainCombinedWhen: Its reference to SourceGeneration is analyzer-only (ReferenceOutputAssembly=false); the generator and its code fixes are what make the kit classes strongly typed, and they must never appear as an assembly dependency.

responsibilities.name: SourceGeneration
responsibilities.purpose: Build-time tooling: the incremental generator that emits kit bases and options, the diagnostics and suppressor, the OptionsHelper code fix, and the attribute sources. Loaded into a consumer's compiler, never into a running application.

responsibilities.name: Example
responsibilities.purpose: Sample Aspire applications that consume the toolkit the way a real AppHost does - one composed through the generated pattern, one wired by hand - plus the service and service-defaults projects they start.
